responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s constraint reasoning layer. It defines bound, range, bounded_range(s), their manager for consolidated switch-case ranges, equivalence-class IDs, relational constraints, fact visitors, and the constraint_manager class that stores and manipulates symbolic equalities, inequalities, and finite ranges for program_state evaluation, pruning, merging, purging, and call-summary replay.
same_name_distinction: Declares the constraint vocabulary and data structures—bounds, ranges, bounded ranges, equivalence classes, relations, visitors, and constraint_manager APIs—while constraint-manager.cc implements the reasoning and testing.
